focused_commands.name: robots-probe
command:
import json
import main_clc_download_notes as notes
import main_uxlc_download_changes as changes
from mb_cmn.polite_download import PoliteDownloadConfig
rows=[]
for module,factory,base in [(notes,notes._notes_config,notes._NOTES_CONFIG),(changes,changes._download_config,changes._UXLC_DOWNLOAD_CONFIG)]:
    for host in ['hcanat.us','tanach.us','example.invalid']:
        config=factory(host)
        expected='Claude-User' if host!='example.invalid' else base.user_agent
        assert config.give_robots_user_agent()==expected
        assert config.give_base_headers()['User-Agent']==base.user_agent
        assert config.obey_robots_txt
        rows.append({'downloader':module.__name__,'host':host,'robots_user_agent':config.give_robots_user_agent(),'header_preserved':True})
assert PoliteDownloadConfig(user_agent='default-probe').give_robots_user_agent()=='default-probe'
print(json.dumps({'offline_host_cases':rows,'default_fallback_passed':True,'network_requests':0}))
